datasets.name: Sentinel-1
datasets.description: C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery. Works through clouds and at night. Ideal for flood mapping, soil moisture, and structural monitoring.

datasets.name: Sentinel-2
datasets.description: Multispectral optical imagery with 13 bands at up to 10m resolution. Best for vegetation analysis, land cover mapping, water body detection, and agricultural monitoring.

datasets.name: Landsat 8
datasets.description: Medium-resolution multispectral imagery with thermal bands. Long historical archive since 2013. Good for land cover change, thermal analysis, and continuity with Landsat 9.

datasets.name: Landsat 9
datasets.description: Latest Landsat satellite with improved radiometric quality. Complements Landsat 8 for 8-day revisit combined.

datasets.name: MODIS
datasets.description: Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer. Daily global coverage at 250m-1km. Excellent for large-area vegetation monitoring, fire detection, and climate studies.

datasets.name: OpenStreetMap
datasets.description: Crowdsourced global map with roads, buildings, land use, water bodies, and points of interest. The most detailed open map dataset available.

datasets.name: Natural Earth
datasets.description: Public domain map dataset with cultural and physical vector data. Ideal for country, state, and regional boundaries at multiple scales.

datasets.name: GADM
datasets.description: Global Administrative Areas database. Provides boundaries for all countries, with sub-national administrative divisions up to 5 levels deep.

datasets.name: ISRO Bhuvan
datasets.description: Indian satellite imagery and GIS data portal. Provides high-resolution Indian satellite imagery, thematic maps, and administrative data specific to India.

datasets.name: ERA5
datasets.description: Global climate reanalysis dataset. Provides hourly estimates of atmospheric, land, and oceanic variables from 1950 to present. The gold standard for climate data.

datasets.name: CHIRPS
datasets.description: Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data. High-resolution daily rainfall estimates, excellent for tropical and subtropical regions.

datasets.name: NASA POWER
datasets.description: Prediction of Worldwide Energy Resources. Provides solar and meteorological data globally. Useful for solar energy potential, agriculture, and climate studies.

datasets.name: Open-Meteo
datasets.description: Free weather API with current, forecast, and historical weather data. No API key required for non-commercial use. Fast and easy to integrate.

datasets.name: Copernicus DEM
datasets.description: Global 30m Digital Elevation Model derived from TanDEM-X radar data. High-quality elevation data for terrain analysis, flood modeling, and slope calculations.

datasets.name: SRTM
datasets.description: Shuttle Radar Topography Mission. Global elevation data at 30m resolution. Widely used benchmark for topographic analysis.

datasets.name: ASTER DEM
datasets.description: Advanced Spaceborne Thermal Emission and Reflection Radiometer Global DEM. Covers 83°N to 83°S latitude.

datasets.name: ESA WorldCover
datasets.description: Global 10m land cover map based on Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 data. 11 land cover classes including tree cover, cropland, built-up, water, and more.

datasets.name: Dynamic World
datasets.description: Near real-time 10m global land use/land cover dataset. Updated continuously with each Sentinel-2 pass. 9 land cover classes with per-pixel probability scores.

datasets.name: WorldPop
datasets.description: High-resolution population density estimates. Uses census data, satellite imagery, and machine learning to map population distribution at ~100m resolution.

datasets.name: GHSL
datasets.description: Global Human Settlement Layer. Maps built-up areas, population grids, and settlement classification from 1975 to present using Landsat and Sentinel data.

datasets.name: NASA FIRMS
datasets.description: Fire Information for Resource Management System. Near real-time active fire data from MODIS and VIIRS satellites. Detects thermal anomalies globally.

datasets.name: SoilGrids
datasets.description: Global soil property maps at 250m resolution. Provides predictions for soil organic carbon, pH, texture, bulk density, and more at multiple depths.

datasets.name: OpenLandMap
datasets.description: Open land and soil data platform. Provides machine-learning-based predictions of soil, vegetation, climate, and terrain properties globally.

datasets.name: data.gov.in
datasets.description: India's open government data platform. Contains datasets on agriculture, water resources, land records, demographics, infrastructure, and more.

datasets.name: Forest Survey of India
datasets.provider: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, India
datasets.description: India State of Forest Report (ISFR) data. Provides district-wise forest cover statistics, change analysis, and forest type mapping for India.

datasets.name: NDMA
datasets.description: India's disaster management data including flood zones, cyclone tracks, earthquake zones, and disaster risk assessments.

datasets.name: OpenAlex
datasets.description: Open catalog of the world's scholarly works. Over 250 million works indexed. Search by topic, author, institution, or concept. Free and open.

datasets.name: Semantic Scholar
datasets.description: AI-powered academic search engine. Provides semantic search, citation graphs, paper summaries, and research trend analysis.

datasets.name: arXiv
datasets.description: Open-access preprint repository for physics, math, computer science, and related fields. Hosts cutting-edge research before peer review.

datasets.name: CORE
datasets.description: World's largest collection of open access research papers. Aggregates from thousands of repositories and journals worldwide.

datasets.name: DOAJ
datasets.description: Directory of Open Access Journals. Indexes peer-reviewed open access journals across all disciplines.

datasets.name: GES DISC
datasets.description: Goddard Earth Sciences Data and Information Services Center. Hosts precipitation (GPM/TRMM), atmospheric composition, and solar irradiance data.

datasets.name: EOS Data Analytics
datasets.description: Satellite data analytics platform providing access to Sentinel, Landsat, and other imagery with built-in vegetation indices and analytics tools.

datasets.name: GeoPlatform
datasets.description: U.S. federal geospatial data portal. Provides access to national map data, infrastructure, environmental, and demographic datasets.

datasets.name: Florida Geographic Data Library
datasets.description: Comprehensive GIS data for Florida including parcels, land use, hydrology, transportation, and environmental layers.
